title: Validate book
sourceTableContract: Required hash-bound ruled or fill-partitioned table evidence, exact cell mapping, rendered fonts and styling in both reader paths. Text scales with the page box above the physical-size floor; a wider host cannot inflate type. Unsupported tables and unmapped typography remain errors and prevent passed status, while independent verified corrections may install.
summary: Local PDF/HTML structure and typography checks, shared CSS without inline declarations, default iframe/article parity, English-first presentation and text-only book-root reports with grouped problem summaries. Preserves source page boundaries with separate cover/title pages and text-preserving page containers, normalizing invalid page anchors before splitting. English becomes the canonical visual template for translations: translated text is preserved while layout roles, typography, display pages, contents structure, colors, spacing and table/list presentation follow English by structural role. Fragmented translated contents are rebuilt into source-toc lists and missing translated blocks are reported clearly. Measures source page padding and restores contents leaders, indentation and page labels. Preserves display alignment and excludes repeated running headers from body-margin estimates and from cross-page paragraph matching. English page folios are not translation counterparts. Preserves source paragraph borders through shared PDF drawing evidence. Detects and recovers flattened source lists with page-continuing numbering and source list typography. Body leading excludes other font sizes; PDF subset faces are grouped into canonical regular/italic/bold/bolditalic CSS families with explicit normal style guards, and partial bold does not promote whole paragraphs. The reader adapter supports generic local-book stylesheet imports and frame/root scale parity. Managed CSS keeps element IDs so later source ID rules cannot override captured title typography and lets descending/default numeric px fallbacks continue to validation.
installationSafety: Pre-install standalone/imported delivery checks; one reader root; exclusive page inset ownership; nested covers; retain recovery until verified success and final-report delivery; preserve recovery on failure.
translationPagination: All languages retain source-proportioned minimum page height, including cover, title, copyright and final pages. Preserve translation page count and breaks; longer content may expand pages. Check minimum page dimensions in standalone and imported readers.
completionContract: Fresh isolated correction passes; retry rejected combined candidates as independent pagination, table, typography, display and structural batches; remeasure after each verified installation; retain rejected attempts and unresolved errors without blocking the book. Runtime failures and concurrent edits abort. Preserve responsive host root geometry from hash-bound CSS.
sourcePublisherRestoration: Explicit opt-in only; source-derived identity and website restoration inside copyright sections; never ordinary narrative rewriting.
translatedMedia: Preserve localized image assets; inherit English rendered image geometry and styling in both reader paths. Source table cell styling preserves translated text and flexible row height; missing or ambiguous media correspondences prevent that repair and remain errors without rejecting independent verified corrections.
cleanup: Before complete, clear previous book-owned jobs and reports, preserving canonical assets and unresolved locks. After verified installation and reporting, clean temporary work even with unresolved validation errors. Runtime failures retain diagnostics until the next fresh run.
